notes.title: Tech Demo- Major QoL Update
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW?
Moved game from Unreal Engine 5.2 to 5.4

Added Minimap System

Updated UI Assets

Added tutorial level

Added tutorial quests (requires manually deleting save folder)

Added new enemy type that uses melee weapons

Updated levels

Finalized Emissions code

Added new main menu

Optimized gameplay

Added new character model

Added animations for using specific items

Added placeable bed

Added placeable object system for customizing base

Added better instructions to Guide tab on the PDA

Including more not listed...




WHAT'S FIXED?
Fixed issue with settings being set to cinematic

Fixed major frame drops

Fixed enemy AI 

Fixed input overlap issues




WHEN IS IT COMING OUT?
The update is planned to release this Saturday 8/9/25 with more bug fixes to follow shortly after if any new major issues arise.




THIS IS THE LAST MAJOR UPDATE FOR THE TECH DEMO
This will be the final major update for the tech demo to allow me to focus on the Early Access launch! Expect more news to be released covering Early Access on the Patreon, there you can keep up with the game's development and also receive a steam key early for supporting the game.

Link to Patreon



Thank you for reading! Please wishlist and share with your friends,

Ghost Dev

notes.title: Tech Demo- Weapon Effects Update
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW?

Weapon overheating with damage to weapon

Visual dirt build up on weapons when durability is low

Redesigned foliage in levels



WHAT'S FIXED?

Fixed bug where menu elements don't appear

Fixed errors inside code to improve performance

Added placeholder death audio that wasn't triggering





STAY TUNED FOR UPCOMING ENEMY AI UPDATE THAT INCLUDES...

Newly designed enemy AI that are grouped into factions

Enemy cover system

Improved movement blending for infected

Creature AI attack pattern and movement improvements

Many more bug fixes and gameplay adjustments



Thank you for reading and please wishlist and share with your friends,

Ghost Dev
